derivations.claim: Rewrite the minimum as (S1+S2-|S1-S2|)/2. Continuity of S1 and S2 and of absolute value implies continuity of the selected model prediction at t0.

With D=S1-S2 and m=D'(t0) nonzero, the derivative definition gives D(t0+h)=mh+o(h). For sufficiently small nonzero h the remainder has magnitude below |m h|/2, so D has the sign of m h and different branches minimize on the two sides.

On each side the minimum equals the selected C1 branch from step 1.2. Its left derivative at t0 is one of the two branch derivatives and its right derivative is the other; since the slopes differ, the model minimum is not differentiable.

Supplement the same model with a two-dimensional regulated boundary code space and constant state rho_boundary=I2/2. Its exact entropy is k_B log 2 for every t. Because the postulate does not identify exact entropy with the two-candidate minimum, this assignment is compatible with the cusp proved in step 2.1; the assumptions therefore do not force an exact finite-cutoff entropy cusp.
